title: What If Humans Never Aged Again?

shots.line: November 14th, 2026. Humanity woke up to something impossible. Nobody was getting older.
Governments declared it the greatest miracle in human history.
But ten years later, the celebration ended.
People were no longer dying of old age. Yet new children were still being born.
Food disappeared. Jobs vanished. Housing became impossible.
The world had a new problem. There were too many people, and almost nobody was leaving.
Humanity had achieved its oldest dream. Immortality. But nobody had asked the most important question...
If nobody can die... who gets to live?
